import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { checkUpgradeOath, confirmUpgradeOath } from '@src/response-apps/companion/upgradeOath/app';
import { sendFifthLayerLockedPage } from '@src/response/access/fifthLayer';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const rawText = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const confirmed = /^[!！/#＃]?升级誓约\s+确认$/.test(rawText);
  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const checkResult = await checkUpgradeOath({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, confirmed, request });

  if (checkResult.data.access && !checkResult.data.access.ok) {
    sendFifthLayerLockedPage({ bid, isPrivate, message, title: '升级誓约', realmName: checkResult.data.access.realmName });

    return;
  }

  if (checkResult.code === 'FAIL') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(checkResult.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const { partnerName, currentBlessingPercent, upgradedBlessingPercent } = checkResult.data;

  if (!confirmed) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(`确定要将你与「${partnerName}」的普通誓约升级为高级誓约吗？`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('升级后将消耗：三生同心笺×1');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`誓约祝福：+${currentBlessingPercent}% -> +${upgradedBlessingPercent}%`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('⚠️ 原普通誓约纪念物「同心玉佩」若仍在背包中，将被直接丢弃，这是升级代价');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('⚠️ 结缘日期、灵契值、同心值都会保留');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('请发送：/升级誓约 确认');

    const footer = [{ label: '确认升级', command: '/升级誓约 确认' }];

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer }));

    return;
  }

  const result = checkResult.data.settledResult ?? (await confirmUpgradeOath({ bid, uid, request }));
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();
  const repeatMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, request);

  md.addText(repeatMsg);

  if (result.code === 'OK') {
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`你与${partnerName}的高级誓约已生效，后续道侣祝福与纪念日档位将按高级誓约结算`));
  }

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
});
